text:
ITEM 1: Flattened pale golden pieces with seared edges, moist and flaky, not glossy. Likely fish fillet (cod/tilapia) or pan-seared chicken breast; fish fillet is most likely given flaky texture.

ITEM 2: Wilted glossy dark leafy greens with thick pale stems: likely cooked chard or spinach; chard is the best fit given the thick pale stems.

1 | Cooked white fish fillet (cod/tilapia, pan-seared) | 68 | 22 | 3 | 0
2 | Cooked Swiss chard (leaves and stems) | 92 | 2 | 0.5 | 3.5
